**Finding submitted — deviation (medium severity), confidence 0.83.**

- **Responsive clause:** Section 10.5 (para p0065) is the only governing-law provision in the document. Targeted searches for "court", "venue", "jurisdiction", "dispute" and "arbitration" returned no other hits, confirming there is no forum-selection or arbitration clause anywhere (and so no walk-away risk of foreign arbitration or a foreign exclusive venue).
- **Assessment:** New York law is our preferred choice of law, so element 1 is already met verbatim. But the Agreement is entirely silent on forum, so neither the preferred New York County venue element nor the fallback forum element is satisfied — a whole checklist element rather than a minor sub-element, hence a deviation rather than compliant.
- **Redline (validated ok:true, minimality passed):** a single `insert_after` p0065 adding one sentence submitting the parties to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County; the existing governing-law sentence is untouched and no ancillary procedure or waiver language was added.
